demos.title: SUSE AI Factory for developers
demos.pitch: A tour for developers: the NVIDIA catalog, the Workspace, Blueprints drawn in the Studio, one-click deploy through SUSE AI Factory with NVIDIA, the Rancher Prime UI and SUSE Observability.

demos.title: Factory operations & visual inspection
demos.pitch: An agent watches three production lines through a vision model, finds defective parts, traces them to the machine and opens tickets a supervisor approves.

demos.title: Fraud detection & investigation
demos.pitch: A fraud model scores every payment; an agent investigates each alert, screens payees and opens cases the analyst must confirm, with customer data kept on premises.

demos.title: Network configuration & autonomous operations
demos.pitch: An agent reads the radio network's KPIs, finds what is wrong, searches the runbooks and validates a fix in the simulator for the NOC engineer to apply.

demos.title: Conversational shopping assistant
demos.pitch: An assistant understands words and photos, checks stock and prepares the order, while the runtime stops it from taking payment or inventing a discount.

demos.title: Ambient clinical documentation
demos.pitch: A consultation is transcribed on the GPU; an agent drafts the SOAP note and leaves the signature and orders to the doctor, with patient data never leaving.

demos.title: Sovereign agentic SecOps
demos.pitch: SUSE Security finds vulnerable images; an agent checks the policy and opens one pull request moving them to SUSE images. A person merges, Fleet deploys, SUSE Security rescans.

demos.title: Traffic incident management
demos.pitch: An agent watches four road cameras through NVIDIA Cosmos Reason2 and asks the control room operator what to do. The operator decides; the agent can't.

demos.title: Sovereign casework
demos.pitch: An agent assesses research proposals on EU-made open models only (EuroLLM), answers the applicant in their language and briefs the programme officer, who decides.

demos.title: Developer Sandbox
demos.pitch: Code with Claude Code on the platform's own model inside an NVIDIA OpenShell sandbox: approved destinations allowed, everything else denied, policy changed live.
